mission_10: Molecular property prediction is a cornerstone of computational drug discovery and materials science. Molecules are naturally represented as graphs where atoms are nodes and bonds are edges, each with rich features. Atom features include element type, degree, hybridization, and formal charge. Bond features include bond type (single, double, triple, aromatic), conjugation, and ring membership. This mission implements a complete molecular GNN that encodes both atom and bond features, performs bond-aware message passing where edge features modulate information flow, and uses multi-scale readout (sum, mean, max pooling) to create a graph-level representation. The multi-task prediction head simultaneously predicts multiple molecular properties like solubility, toxicity, and binding affinity, leveraging shared representations across related tasks.
